title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
苏太虚一脸茫然，不明叶辰为什么会这么问，但还是被这一问陷入了多年前的回忆。一位英俊的公子，和一位仙气飘飘、肤如凝脂的仙女在一起游玩，有说有笑。可后来仙女撒手，离他而去，英俊公子陷入深深的痛苦之中。陷入回忆中的苏太虚，刚开始脸上挂起淡淡笑意，可突然脸上又变成了痛苦的悲伤。叶辰看着苏太虚的变化，这下实锤了，他就是自己的某位师兄，被老头贬下界了。叶辰心里涌起同病相怜的感觉，心里又将无极仙帝狠狠骂了一万遍。远在仙界的无极仙帝今天一连打了好几个喷嚏。“死老头，真不当人。”叶辰边想着，脱口而出道。“你说什么？”苏太虚被叶辰这一喊，从回忆中惊醒。“我说，死老头子不当人。”叶辰想也没想，咬牙切齿脱口而出。“逆徒！”苏太虚以为叶辰在骂自己，怒喝一声，抬脚将叶辰踹了出去。“啊！我的屁股。”叶辰大叫一声，双手捂着屁股，化作抛物线飞出木屋。“轰隆”叶辰掉落在天玄宗广场上，砸出一个人形大坑，摔得灰头土脸，狼狈不堪。四周众多弟子纷纷围上来，看着趴在坑中的叶辰，个个都一脸茫然，不知发生了何事。“啊呸！连踹人都和那老头一模一样，这下实锤了，绝对是那老头的徒弟。”叶辰翻了个身，从坑中爬起，嘴里嘟囔着。“不对，他还没将头磕回来呢，怎么就把我踹出来了！”叶辰想到此次找苏太虚的目的，话还没说就被一脚踹了出来。“哎！算了，所谓长兄如父，自己就吃点亏认了吧！”叶辰非常无奈，只得自我安慰道。正在这时，远处擂台传来一阵激烈的打斗声，吸引了他的注意。围观的弟子也不再关注叶辰这个神神叨叨的大傻逼了，转身朝擂台走去，准备观战。叶辰拉住一个弟子一打听，才知道是宗门五长老和六长老为争夺一个修炼洞府而比武，谁赢了洞府就归谁。叶辰秉持着有热闹不看白不看的信念，也凑上去看热闹。“咦！这个六长老竟然是个老六。”叶辰看着擂台的比武喃喃自语道。

这个六长老隐藏了修为，表面看六长老比五长老低一个小境界。实则六长老比五长老高出两个小境界。擂台上，五长老压着六长老打，可六长老都能游刃有余地化解，很明显这个老六不想暴露修为。叶辰眼睛一亮，这可是赚取灵石的大好机会啊！他麻溜地从乾坤袋掏出一张桌子。“啪”的一声放在地上。“来来来，下注了，下注了！”“买五长老胜一赔十！买六长老胜一赔一！”叶辰扯着嗓子吆喝起来，那叫一个声嘶力竭，不知道的还以为他是什么江湖卖艺的。围观的天玄宗弟子就像看傻子一样看着叶辰。这很明显五长老必胜，还有这种好事？“这小子莫不是个傻子吧！”“五长老必胜，还一赔十？”“管他呢，既然有人送灵石，我们也没有不拿的道理。”说着一群人围过来开始下注。“我买一千下品灵石五长老胜！”一个弟子率先掏出一袋灵石，丢在桌子上。“我买五百！”“我买两千！”所有弟子都买五长老胜，生怕买晚了没机会似的。叶辰看着堆积如山的灵石，嘴角微微上扬，露出一抹腹黑的笑容。“这位师兄，你确定不买六长老胜吗？”叶辰一脸真诚地对一个押注五长老的弟子说道。“一赔一哦，稳赚不赔！”那弟子白了叶辰一眼。“你当我是傻子吗？六长老都快被打趴下了！”“唉，待会儿你们可别怪我没提醒你们啊！”叶辰故作惋惜地摇摇头，一副“我早就告诉过你了”的表情。“小子，你就是叶辰？”一个身材魁梧，肌肉发达的青年，走到叶辰面前，语气有些不善。“我是，找我有事？”叶辰头也没抬地回道，如果是来找茬的他也不介意教育一番。

Su Taixu looked confused. He didn't know why Ye Chen asked this question, but he was still caught up in the memories of many years ago by this question.A handsome young man and a fairy with a fairy spirit and skin as smooth as gel were playing together, talking and laughing.But later the fairy let go and left him, and the handsome young man fell into deep pain.Su Taixu, who was caught in memories, had a faint smile on his face at first, but suddenly his face turned into painful sadness.Ye Chen looked at Su Taixu's changes and realized that he was one of his senior brothers who was demoted to the lower realm by the old man.Ye Chen's heart felt like he was in the same boat, and he scolded Wuji Immortal Emperor ten thousand times in his heart.Immortal Emperor Wuji, who was far away in the Immortal Realm, sneezed several times in a row today."Damn old man, you really don't deserve to be a human being." Ye Chen blurted out while thinking."What did you say?" Su Taixu was awakened from his memories by Ye Chen's shout."I said, this old man is not a human being." Ye Chen blurted out through gritted teeth without even thinking about it."Traitor!" Su Taixu thought Ye Chen was scolding him, shouted angrily, and kicked Ye Chen out."Ah! My butt." Ye Chen yelled, covering his butt with both hands, and flew out of the cabin in a parabola."Boom" Ye Chen fell on the Tianxuanzong Square, making a huge human-shaped crater. He fell into a disgraceful state and was in a miserable state.Many disciples gathered around and looked at Ye Chen lying in the pit. They all looked confused and didn't know what happened."Ah! Even kicking people is exactly the same as that old man. Now it's confirmed that he is definitely the old man's apprentice." Ye Chen turned over and got up from the pit, muttering."No, he hasn't knocked his head back yet, why did he kick me out!" Ye Chen thought of the purpose of looking for Su Taixu this time, and was kicked out before he could say anything."Hey! Forget it, the so-called eldest brother is like a father, so just accept the loss!" Ye Chen was very helpless and could only comfort himself.At this moment, a fierce fighting sound came from the distant arena, attracting his attention.The onlookers no longer paid attention to Ye Chen, a nagging idiot, and turned around and walked towards the ring, preparing to watch the battle.Ye Chen grabbed a disciple and asked about it, only to find out that the fifth elder and the sixth elder of the sect were competing for a training cave. Whoever wins the cave will get it.Ye Chen adhered to the belief that he would not watch the fun in vain, so he also joined in to watch the fun."Hey! This sixth elder is actually the sixth elder." Ye Chen muttered to himself as he watched the competition in the ring.

This sixth elder hides his cultivation level. On the surface, the sixth elder is a small level lower than the fifth elder.In fact, the sixth elder is two small realms higher than the fifth elder.In the ring, the fifth elder pressed down on the sixth elder to fight, but the sixth elder was able to resolve it with ease. It was obvious that the sixth elder did not want to expose his cultivation.Ye Chen's eyes lit up, this was a great opportunity to earn spiritual stones!He quickly took out a table from the Qiankun bag.It was placed on the ground with a "pop" sound."Come on, come on, place your bet, place your bet!" "If you buy the fifth elder, you get ten for one! If you buy the sixth elder, you get one for one!" Ye Chen shouted at the top of his lungs, shouting at the top of his lungs. Those who didn't know thought he was some kind of showman.The Tianxuan Sect disciples who were watching looked at Ye Chen like a fool.It is obvious that the fifth elder will win. Is there such a good thing?"Isn't this kid a fool?" "The fifth elder is bound to win, so why should he pay ten for each one?" "Whatever, since someone is offering spiritual stones, we have no reason not to take them." With that said, a group of people gathered around and started placing bets."I'll buy a thousand low-grade spiritual stones and the five elders will win!" A disciple took out a bag of spiritual stones and threw them on the table."I'll buy five hundred!" "I'll buy two thousand!" All the disciples bought Fifth Elder Sheng, as if they were afraid that they would be too late to buy and have no chance.Ye Chen looked at the mountains of spiritual stones, the corners of his mouth raised slightly, revealing a dark smile."Senior brother, are you sure you don't want to buy the sixth elder's victory?" Ye Chen said sincerely to a disciple who was betting on the fifth elder."You'll pay for it, you're guaranteed to make a profit!" The disciple rolled his eyes at Ye Chen."Do you think I'm a fool? The sixth elder was almost beaten to the ground!" "Oh, don't blame me for not reminding you later!" Ye Chen shook his head pretending to be regretful, with an expression like "I told you so"."Boy, are you Ye Chen?" A tall, muscular young man walked up to Ye Chen with a somewhat unkind tone."I am, do you have a problem with me?" Ye Chen replied without raising his head. If he was looking for trouble, he wouldn't mind educating him.
